$comment: Every translation source the pipeline knows. A corpus source is set up ONCE by scripts/setup-source.mjs <key> (clone at `commit`, build on `toolchain`, per-module Gate 2 exports under data/exports/<key>/, queue data/queue-<key>.json); after that only its source checkout (corpusRoot, default infra/<key>/repo) is needed — the build is deleted. `roots` are the lean_lib module roots that carry records. Translations target `targetToolchain` (the tree's). The queue route, theorem-text route, queue console, pipeline panel, run-recurse.mjs and the bridge all read this file.
